summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — URW.PA +1%, ZAL.DE +1%, HEN3.DE +1%, IHG.L +1%, DTE.DE +0%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (DBK.DE -6%, RMS.PA -5%, SAP.DE -5%, DSY.PA -5%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: DBK.DE (-5.97%) — Leaked-documents media investigation linking the bank to oligarch, Epstein-related and suspicious-payment flows, plus a risk-off AI/tech selloff. Sources date the drop to Nov 17, so the date match is uncertain. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: DBK.DE is a large-cap German bank, apparently not in the tradable lists. It was also a headline-driven gap-down with no earnings signal, and a long-only bot can't short it.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst found for 2026-11-18; the +0.86% gain looks like a modest technical or European real-estate sector move, not a company-specific event.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. URW.PA is a Paris-listed mid/large-cap retail REIT, and no strategy's universe covers it. A +0.86% move on no news is also too small to pass any momentum or gap filter.
top_movers.suggestion: (no actionable change — a +0.86% no-news move doesn't justify widening the universe; only consider adding Euronext Paris REITs if a strategy's min-move threshold, e.g. ≥3% on ≥1.5× avg volume, is met.)
